narration_timeline.text: Look at the goats scattered across this grassy hillside, each moving at its own pace.
narration_timeline.scene: Real managed goat herd on grassy Sunnyvale hillside

narration_timeline.text: In another place, a goat appears in a different landscape, away from the first herd.
narration_timeline.scene: Distinct authentic domestic goat video filmed at Črneča Vas, Slovenia; do not claim specific walking/rocky action unless visible.

narration_timeline.text: Other goats stop to eat hay, while one rests on an open grassy patch.
narration_timeline.scene: Goats eating hay and separately resting on grass

narration_timeline.text: Some goats pause inside a barn, while others groom themselves between activities.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic indoor goat pen followed by a separate genuine goat grooming view; no claim of visible yawning.

narration_timeline.text: Small newborn kids stand near an adult goat, still learning their surroundings.
narration_timeline.scene: Real newborn kids next to adult; no claim nursing

narration_timeline.text: A goat herd has quiet moments, busy moments, and many tiny daily routines.
